arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import semver

# Check all public names exist
print('cmd_bump:', hasattr(semver, 'cmd_bump'))
print('cmd_check:', hasattr(semver, 'cmd_check'))
print('cmd_compare:', hasattr(semver, 'cmd_compare'))
print('createparser:', hasattr(semver, 'createparser'))
print('finalize_version:', hasattr(semver, 'finalize_version'))
print('process:', hasattr(semver, 'process'))
print('VersionInfo.isvalid:', hasattr(semver.VersionInfo, 'isvalid'))

# Test isvalid
print()
print('isvalid(\"1.2.3\"):', semver.VersionInfo.isvalid('1.2.3'))
print('isvalid(\"1.2.3-rc.1+build.1\"):', semver.VersionInfo.isvalid('1.2.3-rc.1+build.1'))
print('isvalid(\"1.2.3alpha\"):', semver.VersionInfo.isvalid('1.2.3alpha'))

# Test CLI
import sys
print()
print('Testing CLI without args...')
try:
    semver.main(cliargs=[])
except SystemExit as e:
    print('SystemExit:', e.code)

print()
print('Testing bump without subcommand...')
try:
    semver.main(cliargs=['bump'])
except SystemExit as e:
    print('SystemExit:', e.code)

print()
print('Testing check...')
r = semver.main(cliargs=['check', '1.2.3'])
print('check result:', r)
"
